title: PoliticalParty
description: A political party. schema:PoliticalParty is a real type and is used unchanged. Kept out of _core because a party is not a government body: it has no jurisdiction it governs and no place in the organizational hierarchy, so the _core Organization requirements do not apply to it.

alternateName.description: Other names or abbreviations this party is known by.

description.description: A plain-language description of the party.

url.description: The party's official page, when one exists.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this party beyond its `@id`.

areaServed.description: The `Jurisdiction` this party contests elections in, where it's specific to one.

dissolutionDate.description: Present means the party no longer exists.
